problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into entering their login credentials on fake websites, leading to account compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all user accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering solutions to detect and block phishing emails
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing campaigns

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing attacks where attackers research and customize messages to specific individuals or roles to increase the likelihood of success.
risk_reduction: Educate employees on recognizing targeted phishing attempts
Use email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Limit publicly available personal and organizational information

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive or finance department email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data.
risk_reduction: Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email accounts for unusual login locations or behaviors
Implement strict approval workflows for financial transactions
